decisions.problem: Free articles are live, but equal-age 24h/72h/7d PV, engagement, CTA-click and purchase metrics are not yet available.
decisions.change: Do not mass-rewrite CTA or change prices tonight. Hold additional speculative free-volume expansion until the first comparable 24h window is available.
decisions.expectedMetric: cleaner attribution for free->paid conversion once measurements arrive
decisions.requiredSample: at minimum equal-age 24h observations, then 72h and 7d
decisions.risk: premature optimization would destroy attribution and could lower conversion
decisions.rollback: not applicable because no customer-facing change was made

decisions.problem: Purchase qualification depends on the usefulness and clarity of the free area before the paywall.
decisions.change: Require empathy/question framing, a concrete change/example, and a clear statement of buyer value in the free area before packaging.
decisions.expectedMetric: paid-boundary conversion once article-level PV and purchases become measurable
decisions.requiredSample: compare future articles only after comparable exposure windows
decisions.risk: over-expanding free content could reduce paid differentiation; preserve clear incremental paid value
decisions.rollback: shorten only the parts that duplicate paid value while retaining the three qualification elements

decisions.asset: Microsoft Store CSV Cleaner & Duplicate Remover
decisions.problem: No live Store listing exists yet, so there is no Store-page baseline for ASO, CVR or acquisition optimization.
decisions.change: Prioritize Partner Center identity/submission prerequisites. Defer listing experiments and pricing tests until the first live baseline exists.
decisions.expectedMetric: Store page views, acquisitions, installs and conversion after publication
decisions.requiredSample: first live baseline before any A/B or price experiment
decisions.risk: optimizing before publication provides no attributable revenue evidence
decisions.rollback: not applicable because no listing experiment was launched

decisions.problem: Product-level sales and outbound conversion data are unavailable.
decisions.change: Keep current public offers stable; prepare only coherent context-matched bundle/CTA candidates and wait for measurable demand before live pricing or multi-CTA changes.
decisions.expectedMetric: order value, conversion or attributed outbound conversion after instrumentation exists
decisions.requiredSample: observed product-level sales or click/conversion data
decisions.risk: speculative bundling or extra CTA can dilute intent
decisions.rollback: remove the experimental bundle/CTA if measured conversion deteriorates against baseline

noClaims: No uplift, winner, loser or optimal price is claimed without first-party measurement.
